item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera shines a torch so that several parallel light rays fall on three different mirrors in her science lab at school: a plane mirror, a concave mirror and a convex mirror. Which row correctly describes how the parallel rays are reflected by all three mirrors?

options.A: All three mirrors reflect the parallel rays as parallel rays, because each ray obeys the law of reflection.
options.B: The plane mirror keeps the rays parallel, the concave mirror makes them converge, and the convex mirror makes them diverge.
options.C: The plane mirror keeps the rays parallel, the concave mirror makes them diverge, and the convex mirror makes them converge.
options.D: The plane mirror makes the rays converge, the concave mirror keeps them parallel, and the convex mirror makes them diverge.
